# agent-harness-evals

> agent-harness-evals is a reconciliation layer over public AI evaluation leaderboards that exposes the model x agent-harness matrix model-only leaderboards hide: which harness gets the most out of each model, and how much the harness alone moves the score.

The same model does not score the same under every agent harness. This project fetches published leaderboard data (the Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub, refreshed about daily under CC-BY, plus the HAL harness leaderboards as a historical snapshot), reconciles model and harness names into one (benchmark, model, harness, score) record, and pivots the result per benchmark into a model x harness matrix with a per-model spread — best harness minus worst — so the harness contribution can be read with the model held fixed. As of 2026-09-07 it holds 6382 records over 89 benchmarks, with 41 models and 50 harnesses on 10 cross-harness boards. It runs no evaluations: every score is a third-party published number, republished with its source.

Reproduce it: `pip install -r requirements.txt && python src/fetch.py && python src/normalize.py && python src/views_harness.py && python src/build_site.py`.

## Docs
- [Live matrix](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/): per benchmark, the model x harness matrix, a harness ranking and a model ranking
- [Score trend](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/trend.html): score over time, one line per harness
- [Method and record schema](https://github.com/alloevil/agent-harness-evals#record-schema): how model and harness ids are reconciled across sources
- [Status and limitations](https://github.com/alloevil/agent-harness-evals#status--limitations): which harness data is live, which is a snapshot

## Data
- [Daily snapshots](https://github.com/alloevil/agent-harness-evals/tree/master/data/snapshots): one JSONL per day of normalized records, diffable history
- [Harness matrices](https://github.com/alloevil/agent-harness-evals/tree/master/views): per-benchmark model x harness CSV and Markdown, with spread and n

## Evidence
- [claims.json](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/claims.json): every number on this site with metric, method, repro command and evidence
- [llms-full.txt](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/llms-full.txt): self-contained description, install, limits and FAQ

## Benchmarks
- [Terminal-Bench](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#terminalbench): 30 models x 37 harnesses. Agentic tasks in a real shell — coding, sysadmin, data wrangling. Score = share of tasks passed.
- [CORE-Bench Hard](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_corebench_hard): 15 models x 3 harnesses. Reproduce computational results from real research papers. (HAL)
- [GAIA](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_gaia): 11 models x 2 harnesses. General-assistant questions needing web search, browsing, and tool use. (HAL)
- [SWE-bench Verified Mini](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_swebench_verified_mini): 11 models x 2 harnesses. 50-task subset of SWE-bench Verified — fix real GitHub issues. Score = share of issues resolved. (HAL)
- [SciCode](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_scicode): 7 models x 3 harnesses. Implement code for problems drawn from research-level science. (HAL)
- [τ-bench Airline](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_taubench_airline): 9 models x 2 harnesses. Customer-service dialogues with tool calls under airline policies. (HAL)
- [Online-Mind2Web](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_online_mind2web): 7 models x 2 harnesses. Live website navigation tasks on the real web. (HAL)
- [ScienceAgentBench](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_scienceagentbench): 5 models x 2 harnesses. Data-driven scientific-discovery tasks end to end. (HAL)
- [BTF3](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#btf3): 2 models x 2 harnesses. Epoch agent×model board. Score = share of tasks passed.
- [USACO](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#hal_usaco): 1 model x 2 harnesses. Olympiad competitive-programming problems. (HAL)
- [FrontierCode](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#frontiercode): native-pairing board, each model under its vendor's own harness. Hard, unpublished competitive-programming-style coding tasks (Epoch board).
- [PostTrainBench](https://alloevil.github.io/agent-harness-evals/#posttrainbench): native-pairing board, each model under its vendor's own harness. Agents fine-tune a base LLM on a target task; score reflects the post-trained model's quality.
